note: Observed cloud dataset projected to factual fields. Captions, descriptions, social titles and image URLs are omitted; content_hash belongs to the original full row. Source observations are historical, not current promises.
limits: Search returns only the first public keyword response, usually up to 30 cards; searchLimit is an upper bound, not guaranteed depth. No pagination, top charts, complete publisher catalogues, download/revenue estimates, reviews or private data. ID lookup adds version, update date, rating count and developer website when exposed; these may be null in search rows. Installs is the public rounded label, not an exact download total. Price is the upfront storefront price, not subscription or in-app purchase cost. Countries select storefronts, language selects listing text. No currency conversion.
